sql_functions_needed.name: buscar_memoria_usuario
sql_functions_needed.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION buscar_memoria_usuario(p_user_id UUID, p_limit INT DEFAULT 5)
RETURNS TABLE(content TEXT) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT mf.content
  FROM memory_fragments mf
  WHERE mf.user_id = p_user_id
  ORDER BY mf.created_at DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

sql_functions_needed.name: adicionar_xp
sql_functions_needed.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION adicionar_xp(p_user_id UUID, p_xp INT)
RETURNS VOID AS $$
DECLARE
  v_novo_xp INT;
  v_novo_nivel INT;
BEGIN
  UPDATE user_profiles
  SET xp = xp + p_xp
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  RETURNING xp INTO v_novo_xp;

  -- Calcula novo nível baseado no XP total
  v_novo_nivel := CASE
    WHEN v_novo_xp >= 7000 THEN 7
    WHEN v_novo_xp >= 3500 THEN 6
    WHEN v_novo_xp >= 1800 THEN 5
    WHEN v_novo_xp >= 900  THEN 4
    WHEN v_novo_xp >= 400  THEN 3
    WHEN v_novo_xp >= 150  THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END;

  UPDATE user_profiles
  SET level = v_novo_nivel
  WHERE id = p_user_id;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
